title: ProfileCaptureSettings
description:
Capture inputs the CLI ran with, so a later `profile refresh` can replay them
without flags. Null for the CDP saveProfile path and any future non-CLI creator.
Never holds the token, and omits server/region because a stale stored region
is a guaranteed 404.

profile.description: Raw `--profile` value (source profile directory or display name).

excludeDomains.description:
Effective merged exclusion list. `[]` is meaningful — "captured with no
exclusions" — and distinct from absent, which means "unknown".

onlyDomains.description: Normalized `--only-domain` hostnames, deduped and capped — not merged with local config.

keepDomains.description: Normalized `--keep-domain` hostnames, same normalization, no merge.

cliVersion.description: CLI version that produced these settings, for drift diagnosis.
